claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Corning 之後的 10-Q、10-K、8-K 或法說寫出這些長約被取消、縮減、延後，或光通訊事業的 Gen AI 營收衰退、客戶預付回沖；或 Amazon 一手寫出改用其他光纖供應商。核查頻率：每季（Corning 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀光纖層讀圖的需求側。
claims.statement: Corning 8-K Q3 2026 (EX-99, 2026-10-27): Corning secured four long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements in Q3 (including Verizon and AT&T), and its capacity additions are backed by long-term customer agreements that share the cost and risk of expansions — customers bear part of the expansion cost (customer-to-supplier commitment). Amounts and the other two counterparties are not disclosed in this document.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC 8-K 附件 99（公開申報）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。
source_doc.title: Corning 8-K Q3 2026 新聞稿（EX-99，2026-10-27）：第三季簽下四份長期、數十億美元的客戶協議（含 Verizon、AT&T）；擴產由分攤擴產成本與風險的長期客戶協議支撐

sources.quote: In the third quarter, Corning secured four long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements, including with Verizon and AT&T.
To support that growth, we have steadily added capacity, backed by long-term customer agreements that share the cost and risk of expansions.
